title: A Unifying Bias-aware Multidisciplinary Framework for Investigating Socio-Technical Issues

bias_targets.methodology: Applying Topic Modeling (CorEx), Sentiment Analysis with Explainable AI (SHAP), and Latent Class Analysis on interview transcripts and survey data to compare vulnerabilities, discrimination, and negative experiences across six minoritised ethnic groups (African, Bangladeshi, Indian, Chinese, Pakistani, Caribbean) accessing digitalized social housing.

Evaluating the impact of English proficiency on users' negative experiences by analyzing interview transcripts using fine-tuned sentiment analysis models and extracting significant barrier-related words via SHAP explanations.

Using Topic Modeling and Latent Class Analysis on interview and survey data to identify and group vulnerabilities related to digital poverty, lack of digital literacy, and disparities in housing tenure.
